name: Carlazzo (Italy)
description: White field with a blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carlazzo (a star above a bridge on green and blue) within branches and the inscription COMUNE DI CARLAZZO in grey above.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 12 February 2026.

features.role: Carlazzo arms — star above a bridge, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CARLAZZO above the arms
